taskDescription: Goal: keep Launcher releasable and handoff-lossless across sessions, ship v0.8.0 safely, then make lock screen behaviour match Tj's strict requirement without breaking anything (safety first, L10). Core intent: lock screen from ANY launcher at ANY time shows rotation tile only in quick settings, never Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/notifications, lock number always at bottom, power menu always hides Screenshot. Stock Quickstep v10 is the visual ground truth.

Approach: listing CI runs and long log tails → Result: 10 KB+ outputs because run listings echo head commit message → Lesson: keep ckpt text short; confirm green via get_workflow_run conclusion; fetch long tail (>=110 lines) only on failure.

Approach: full emulator gate runs → Result: one died with 'emulator went offline' (infra), another hung 25 min → Lesson: cancel and redispatch only the unreached sections.

implicitRules: Stack: Java (not Kotlin), Android 10 API 29, Go-edition launcher; Tj's Android 16 preference does not apply here.
First action each session: bash tools/install-hooks.sh. Checkpoint after every step: bash tools/ckpt.sh "did" "next" with short text.
New Tj request goes into TASKS.md in his words before any code; a Tj message is answered, never dropped.
Tj's photos never enter the repo (public repo, autosave git add -A). Describe photos in words without name, ID or number.
Never commit secrets or keystore (app/sideload.jks gitignored; tools/keystore.fingerprint committed).
GitHub MCP tools only (no gh CLI); hooks block curl to api.github.com; never work around.
CI only via emulator.yml (sections input) and android.yml (full_build); no push triggers on workflows (minutes are scarce).
Local Gradle only via bash tools/gradle.sh, one at a time; never ./gradlew directly.
Live cable session with Tj: one short step per message, command in last message of turn.
Refer to Tj by name; no gendered pronouns.
